site_settings_value_by_type_check.name: site_settings_value_by_type_check
site_settings_value_by_type_check.value: ("site_settings"."type" = 'image' and "site_settings"."value" is not null and char_length(trim("site_settings"."value")) > 0) or ("site_settings"."type" = 'text' and "site_settings"."value" is null)

tour_plans_name_check.name: tour_plans_name_check
tour_plans_name_check.value: (jsonb_typeof("tour_plans"."name") = 'object' and jsonb_typeof("tour_plans"."name"->'vi') = 'string' and length(btrim("tour_plans"."name"->>'vi')) > 0) is true
